title: walk.rs: only 3 unit tests; RFC 8621 §4.1.4 table example not fully covered
description: walk.rs has 3 unit tests (simple text/plain, multipart/alternative, multipart/mixed+attachment). RFC 8621 §4.1.4 has an 11-part worked example with a reference output table. None of the tests exercise: multipart/related, nested alternative-within-mixed, the cross-population rule (html-only alternative mirrors to textBody), or the nullification path (in_alternative sets html_body=None on text/plain). A future change to parse_structure() could break these cases silently.
